coverage.sources: House and Senate disclosures: Kadoa congress-trading-monitor snapshot (filings through 2026-09-22) plus the Quantity Capital tape

measure: Share of stock purchases by members of Congress (House and Senate), counting trades, 11 sectors

lines: Rising: Tech, from 17% of purchases (2014–2025 average) to 22% in the 3 years to August 8, 2026.
shifts.rule: Count-share change of at least 3 points against the long-run average; member-cluster bootstrap interval excludes zero (Bonferroni over 22 tests) both counting trades and counting each member equally; same direction by at least 1.5 points each member equal and without the 5 most active members; passes at this as-of and the previous 3 weekly as-ofs.
